4. Strychnine is an alkaloid derived from the seeds of the Strychnos nux-vomica tree. It's highly toxic and has been used as a pesticide.

- Curare (derived from plants in the Strychnos and Chondrodendron genera)
- Digitoxin (derived from Digitalis plants/foxglove)
